## 1. Data Processing

```{r}
# Load raw data
df <- read.csv("raw_data.csv")
nrow(df)
```

```{r}
# Variables whose previous-match values we want to retain
prev_vars <- c(
  "minutes_played",
  "total_distance_m"
)

# Add previous-match information
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert match_date to Date
    match_date = as.Date(match_date)
  ) %>%
  
  # Drop rows where the player never actually appeared (0 distance covered), so they aren't treated as a previous match
  filter(total_distance_m > 0) %>%

  # Put each player's appearances in chronological order
  arrange(
    tournament_year,
    player_tournament_id,
    match_date,
    fifa_match_number
  ) %>%

  # Previous matches must be computed separately within each tournament/player
  group_by(tournament_year, player_tournament_id) %>%

  mutate(
    # Match metadata from previous appearance
    prev_match_id = lag(match_id),
    prev_match_date = lag(match_date),

    # Days since previous appearance
    recovery_days = as.integer(match_date - prev_match_date),

    # Previous-match statistics
    across(
      all_of(prev_vars),
      lag,
      .names = "prev_{.col}"
    )
  ) %>%

  ungroup()
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  # Filter out rows where player played less than 10 minutes
  filter(
    !(is.na(minutes_played) | minutes_played < 10)
  ) %>%
  
  # Normalize statistics by minutes played
  mutate(
    normalized_total_distance_m = total_distance_m / minutes_played,
    normalized_pressing_direct = pressing_direct / minutes_played
  ) %>%
  
  # Add binned minutes_played column
  mutate(
    binned_minutes_played = cut(minutes_played, breaks = c(0, 45, 89, max(minutes_played)), include.lowest = TRUE)
  )

nrow(df)
```

## 2. Data Visualization

### Running Rate

```{r}
# Running Rate Distribution by Position
df %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = normalized_total_distance_m,
    color = position,
    fill = position
  )) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.15) +
  labs(
    title = "Running Rate Distribution by Position",
    x = "Running rate (meters per minute)",
    y = "Density",
    color = "Position",
    fill = "Position"
  )
```

```{r}

  "prev_minutes_played",
  "prev_total_distance_m",
  "recovery_days",

)], gap = 0, pch = ".")
```

```{r}

```

```{r}

    color = binned_minutes_played
  )) +

```

```{r}
# Within-Player Running Rate vs. Recovery Days
df %>%
  filter(!is.na(recovery_days)) %>%
  group_by(player_tournament_id) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_dev = recovery_days - mean(recovery_days),
    running_rate_dev = normalized_total_distance_m - mean(normalized_total_distance_m)

  ggplot(aes(
    x = recovery_dev,
    y = running_rate_dev,

  facet_wrap(~position) +

    title = "Within-Player Running Rate vs. Recovery Days",
    x = "Recovery days relative to player average",
    y = "Running rate relative to player average (m/min)",
    color = "Minutes played"
  )
```

## 3. Modeling

### Running Rate

```{r}
# Ignore rows corresponding to first game at the tournament for a player (missing previous game data)
df_filtered <- df %>% filter(!is.na(recovery_days))
```


```{r}
# normalized_total_distance_m ~ 1 + recovery_days + position
fit1 <- lm(normalized_total_distance_m ~
             recovery_days +
             position,
           data = df_filtered)
summary(fit1)
```

```{r}
# Add ns(minutes_played, df=4)
fit2 <- lm(normalized_total_distance_m ~
             recovery_days +
             position +
             ns(minutes_played, df=4),
           data = df_filtered)
summary(fit2)
```

```{r}
# Add prev_total_distance_m
fit3 <- lm(normalized_total_distance_m ~
             recovery_days +
             position +
             prev_total_distance_m +
             ns(minutes_played, df=4),
           data = df_filtered)
summary(fit3)
```

```{r}
# Add random_effect(team_tournament_id)
fit4 <- lmer(normalized_total_distance_m ~
               recovery_days +
               position +
               prev_total_distance_m +
               ns(minutes_played, df=4) +
               (1 | team_tournament_id),
             data = df_filtered)
summary(fit4)
```

```{r}
# Add random_effect(player_tournament_id)
fit5 <- lmer(normalized_total_distance_m ~
               recovery_days +
               position +
               prev_total_distance_m +
               ns(minutes_played, df=4) +
               (1 | team_tournament_id) +
               (1 | player_tournament_id),
             data = df_filtered)
summary(fit5)
```

```{r}
final_running_rate_fit = fit5
```

```{r}
# Plot spline curve for minutes_played by fixing recovery days and previous-match distance to median values and random effects set to 0
spline_grid <- expand.grid(
  minutes_played = seq(min(df_filtered$minutes_played), max(df_filtered$minutes_played), by = 1),
  position = sort(unique(df_filtered$position)),
  recovery_days = median(df_filtered$recovery_days),
  prev_total_distance_m = median(df_filtered$prev_total_distance_m)
)
spline_grid$fitted <- predict(final_running_rate_fit, newdata = spline_grid, re.form = NA)

# Overlay fitted curves on the observed data
df_filtered %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = minutes_played,
    y = normalized_total_distance_m,
    color = position
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = spline_grid, aes(y = fitted), linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Fitted Running Rate vs. Minutes Played by Position",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Recovery days = ", spline_grid$recovery_days[1],
      ", Previous-match distance = ", round(spline_grid$prev_total_distance_m[1]), " m"
    ),
    x = "Minutes played",
    y = "Running rate (meters per minute)",
    color = "Position"
  )
```

```{r}
# Extract random intercepts and their conditional standard errors
running_rate_re <- as.data.frame(ranef(final_running_rate_fit, condVar = TRUE)) %>%
  rename(intercept = condval, se = condsd)

# Team random intercepts, with team name and tournament year attached
team_info <- df_filtered %>%
  distinct(team_tournament_id, team, tournament_year)

team_re <- running_rate_re %>%
  filter(grpvar == "team_tournament_id") %>%
  transmute(team_tournament_id = as.character(grp), intercept, se) %>%
  left_join(team_info, by = "team_tournament_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(intercept))

# Player random intercepts, with player name, team, and position attached
player_info <- df_filtered %>%
  distinct(player_tournament_id, player_name, team, tournament_year, position)

player_re <- running_rate_re %>%
  filter(grpvar == "player_tournament_id") %>%
  transmute(player_tournament_id = as.character(grp), intercept, se) %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "player_tournament_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(intercept))
```

```{r}
tail(team_re, 10)
```

```{r}
# Top/bottom 10 player random intercepts
player_re %>% select(player_name, team, tournament_year, position, intercept, se) %>% head(10)
player_re %>% select(player_name, team, tournament_year, position, intercept, se) %>% tail(10)
```

```{r}
# Famous players to always show in the dot and whisker plot (if present in the model)

  "2026_BELGIUM_KEVIN_DE_BRUYNE_7",
  "2026_SPAIN_PEDRI_20",
  "2022_ENGLAND_BELLINGHAM_JUDE_22",
  "2026_GERMANY_JAMAL_MUSIALA_10",
  # DF
  "2026_NETHERLANDS_VIRGIL_VAN_DIJK_4",
  "2022_MOROCCO_HAKIMI_ACHRAF_2",

)

# Famous teams to always show in the team dot and whisker plot
famous_teams <- c("Argentina", "Brazil", "France", "England", "Germany", "Spain", "Portugal")

# Number of evenly spaced players/teams (by intercept rank) to show per panel
n_spread <- 4

player_re_subset <- player_re %>%
  mutate(famous = player_tournament_id %in% famous_players) %>%
  group_by(position) %>%
  arrange(intercept, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  filter(famous | row_number() %in% round(seq(1, n(), length.out = n_spread))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(player_name, " (", team, " ", tournament_year, ")"))

team_re_subset <- team_re %>%
  mutate(famous = team %in% famous_teams) %>%
  group_by(tournament_year) %>%
  arrange(intercept, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  filter(famous | row_number() %in% round(seq(1, n(), length.out = n_spread))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# Dot and whisker plot of player random intercepts (95% intervals) by position
player_re_subset %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = intercept,
    y = reorder(label, intercept)
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = intercept - 1.96 * se, xmax = intercept + 1.96 * se), height = 0) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~position, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Player Random Intercepts for Running Rate by Position",
    x = "Random intercept (meters per minute)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title.position = "plot")
```

```{r, fig.height=6}
# Dot and whisker plot of team random intercepts (95% intervals) by tournament year
team_re_subset %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = intercept,
    y = reorder(team_tournament_id, intercept)
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = intercept - 1.96 * se, xmax = intercept + 1.96 * se), height = 0) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~tournament_year, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) team_info$team[match(x, team_info$team_tournament_id)]) +
  labs(
    title = "Team Random Intercepts for Running Rate by Tournament",
    x = "Random intercept (meters per minute)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title.position = "plot")
```
